title.zh: 俄罗斯央行发放首批加密交易所与托管牌照并推进零售交易
title.en: Russia's central bank issues first crypto exchange and custodian licenses

current_state.zh: 俄罗斯央行将第17家公司加入其加密货币交易所登记册，同时Sberbank和VTB准备在11月和12月向散户客户提供比特币及其他代币，每家中介机构年度上限为30万卢布，正快速落实9月1日生效的数字货币法。
current_state.en: The Bank of Russia added a 17th firm to its crypto exchange register and, with Sberbank and VTB preparing to offer Bitcoin and other coins to retail customers in November and December under a 300,000-rouble annual cap per intermediary, is rapidly implementing the digital currencies law that took effect on 1 September.

updates.title_zh: 俄罗斯根据新法律批准首批加密货币交易所和托管机构
updates.title_en: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
updates.what_changed_zh: 俄罗斯央行公布了首批持牌加密货币交易所运营商（T-Invest Lab、Zefir、Sistema-Crypto、VTB）和数字托管机构（Sberbank、Atomyze、Voltari、Cloud Infrastructure、VTB）注册名单，Sberbank计划于12月1日推出比特币、以太币和USDT产品。
updates.what_changed_en: The Bank of Russia published its first registers of licensed crypto exchange operators (T-Invest Lab, Zefir, Sistema-Crypto, VTB) and digital custodians (Sberbank, Atomyze, Voltari, Cloud Infrastructure, VTB), with Sberbank planning to launch Bitcoin, Ether and USDT products on Dec. 1.

updates.title_zh: 【俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行获准开展加密货币兑换业务，计划 12 月 1 日上线】
updates.title_en: 【俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行获准开展加密货币兑换业务，计划 12 月 1 日上线】
updates.what_changed_zh: 俄罗斯央行将Sberbank列入数字货币兑换机构名录，使其从数字存管机构扩展为可提供加密货币兑换服务的交易所运营商。
updates.what_changed_en: The Bank of Russia added Sberbank to the digital-currency exchange operator register, expanding its role from digital custodian to exchange operator able to offer crypto conversion services.
updates.current_state_zh: Sberbank已同时获得数字存管机构和数字货币兑换机构资质，可提供加密货币兑换及存管服务，首批产品计划于12月1日上线。
updates.current_state_en: Sberbank is now licensed both as a digital custodian and a digital-currency exchange operator, enabling crypto conversion and custody services, with first products planned for Dec. 1.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Russia's central bank has registered Sberbank as a digital-currency exchange operator, enabling the country's largest bank to offer crypto conversion services to customers through existing interfaces, with first products planned for December 1.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Russia's central bank has registered Sberbank as a digital-currency exchange operator, enabling the country's largest bank to offer crypto conversion services to customers through existing interfaces, with first products planned for December 1.

updates.title_zh: 俄罗斯批准Sberbank在12月上线前进行加密货币交易
updates.title_en: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
updates.what_changed_zh: 俄罗斯央行授权Sberbank（以及VTB等公司）作为持牌加密货币交易所运营商和托管机构，该银行准备从2026年12月1日起通过其平台提供BTC、ETH和USDT交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.
updates.current_state_zh: 俄罗斯央行授权Sberbank（以及VTB等公司）作为持牌加密货币交易所运营商和托管机构，该银行准备从2026年12月1日起通过其平台提供BTC、ETH和USDT交易。
updates.current_state_en: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.

updates.title_zh: 俄罗斯央行批准17家加密货币交易所，Sberbank和VTB准备散户交易
updates.title_en: Bank of Russia clears 17 crypto exchangers as Sberbank and VTB ready retail trading
updates.what_changed_zh: 俄罗斯央行将第17家公司加入其加密货币交易所登记册，同时Sberbank和VTB准备在11月和12月向散户客户提供比特币及其他代币，每家中介机构年度上限为30万卢布，正快速落实9月1日生效的数字货币法。

updates.detailed_summary_en: The Bank of Russia added a 17th firm to its crypto exchange register and, with Sberbank and VTB preparing to offer Bitcoin and other coins to retail customers in November and December under a 300,000-rouble annual cap per intermediary, is rapidly implementing the digital currencies law that took effect on 1 September.
updates.background_zh: 作为框架性立法的第282-FZ号联邦法（8月4日通过）于9月1日生效，设立了由俄罗斯央行管理的加密货币兑换商与数字托管机构名录。据国际文传电讯社报道，Sberbank与VTB是10月6日首批获批的五家数字托管机构之一，VTB当日同时被列入兑换商名录，Sberbank则于10月12日进入兑换商名录。VTB的经纪部门于10月6日完成了面向企业客户的首批稳定币交易；Sberbank则于9月1日为外贸企业推出加密支付，此前央行自2024年9月起已在实验性法律机制下开展试点。
updates.background_en: The framework law, Federal Law No. 282-FZ of 4 August, took effect on 1 September and set up Bank of Russia registers for crypto exchange providers and digital depositories. Sberbank and VTB were among the first five digital depositories approved on 6 October, when VTB was also listed as an exchange provider; Sberbank joined the exchange register on 12 October, Interfax reported. VTB's broker carried out its first stablecoin deals for corporate clients on 6 October, and Sberbank launched crypto payments for foreign-trade companies on 1 September, following a central bank pilot that had run under an experimental legal regime since September 2024.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于准入而非供给：俄罗斯的零售加密需求将通过少数持牌银行和托管机构流转，每个中介机构每年30万卢布的上限限制了单一渠道的资金规模，并促使买家分散至多家机构。已由Sberbank和VTB用于企业客户的跨境结算许可，是与稳定币流动和卢布计价加密流动性关联最直接的部分。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is access rather than supply: retail demand for crypto in Russia will flow through a small set of licensed banks and depositories, with a 300,000-rouble annual cap per intermediary limiting how much can move through any single venue and creating an incentive to spread purchases across providers. The cross-border settlement allowance, already used by Sberbank and VTB for corporate clients, is the segment most directly tied to stablecoin flows and rouble-denominated crypto liquidity.
